Authentication and identity.evidence: Connect identity/profile/session tables exist; complete registration/login/password reset/Argon2 workflow is not implemented in Connect.

Authorization and tenant isolation.evidence: Core services enforce ownership/membership in several workflows; advanced phase services use inconsistent/in-memory checks.

Profiles and network.evidence: Persistent profiles, privacy, follow, connection, block and negative tests exist.

Research feed.evidence: Persistent posts, comments, reactions, bookmarks, reposts, moderation and tests exist.

Messaging.evidence: Persistent conversations/messages/receipts/realtime replay exist; complete forward/edit/delete/retention/project-event chat coverage is incomplete.

Calls and meetings.evidence: Real browser WebRTC client and authenticated signaling implemented; independent-browser/TURN/SFU qualification outstanding.

Projects, tasks and milestones.evidence: Project/resource services exist; task/milestone/calculated-progress implementation is incomplete.

Documents, ELN and data rooms.evidence: Phase B uses fake export URLs, in-memory notebook/data-room state and caller-provided signature strings.

Grants, consortia and DAC.evidence: Service methods and tests exist but primary state is process-memory only.

Peer review, preprints and trust.evidence: Service methods and tests exist but primary state is process-memory only.

Knowledge graph and expert matching.evidence: Service methods exist but graph and consultation state are process-memory only; matching coverage is limited.

Marketplace, equipment, events and mento.evidence: Service methods exist but state is process-memory only and advanced UI pages are placeholders.

Developer API and webhooks.evidence: Webhook trigger returns delivered without HTTP; secrets stored plaintext in memory.

Analytics and trends.evidence: Hardcoded analytics and trend rows violate the specification.

Preservation.evidence: Returns archived_permanently and random checksum without creating an archive.

Advanced UI pages.evidence: Pages 326-338 contain only title plus Active & Qualified info.

Windows installation.evidence: Multiple scripts exist, but conflicting installer versions and stale packaging references require canonicalization.

Automated testing.evidence: 45/46 Connect tests pass baseline; many advanced tests assert returned dictionaries rather than persistence/artifacts/delivery.

Final packaging.evidence: Prior single preview ZIP exists; required strict allowlist four-part CONNECT-COMPLETE release not built.
